cases.claim: Uncertain explosion mechanism limits predicted abundances of certain isotopes.
Publication metadata and article title establish a scientific conclusion.
Authors calculate explosive nucleosynthesis for differing deflagration speeds and ignition densities.
Authors performed calculations involving slow deflagration and delayed detonation or fast deflagration.
Some neutron-rich iron-group isotope abundances are sensitive to electron capture in central layers.
The models favor transition densities slightly below 2.2e7 g/cm3.
Flame speed is identified as relevant to nucleosynthesis outcome.
Some isotope ratios fall within a factor of two to three of solar ratios in the discussed model context.
